defects.what: Instead of a figure of light breaking into points of light, the spiral holds a cute chibi grinning toddler flying with arms out, in a cartoon baby style that breaks the episode's realistic anime look and clashes with the terror/ego-death moment.

The 'smiling stranger' Indio walks away from is drawn as a black-haired Filipino man with a low ponytail in plain street clothes, nothing like the blond/ash-haired foreigner in pale safari clothes established as the visitor Sinag in the shots just before.
Usman is drawn as a stocky Labrador-type dog with BOTH ears folded down in every shot; the model sheet calls for a slim short-haired street dog with only ONE folded ear.
The visitor Sinag's hair colour changes between his shots within the same episode, brown in k21 and k62 but blond in k22/k24 and ash-blond in k63, so the same character is not consistent.
Indio wears a red cloth/band on BOTH wrists in these shots; the character spec gives him a red handkerchief on the left wrist only.
Indio's red handkerchief is tied at his neck like a scout neckerchief instead of on his wrist.
Indio is drawn in a black collared shirt with short slicked hair and no topknot, instead of his white t-shirt and black topknot.
The glowing jaguar's two front legs come together at the bottom and fuse into a single wide paw-blob with an unclear number of toes.
defects.where: the jaguar's front paws, lower centre

defects.what: The stacked books are rendered in a softer painterly filter and their edges melt into one another so individual volumes are hard to separate.
